nodes.name: Sklearn Feature Selection Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level RFE, RFECV, SelectFromModel, and SequentialFeatureSelector selection, callback-payload, and fitted-state atoms above estimator, importance, scorer, and CV callback boundaries.

nodes.name: feature_selector_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public sklearn feature-selector names useful for framework-level selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public selector-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: feature_selector_family
nodes.description: Return the selector family represented by a public estimator name.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a dictionary lookup over fixed selector names.

nodes.name: feature_selector_boundary
nodes.description: Return the estimator, importance, scorer, or CV callback boundary represented by a public feature selector.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed selector names.

nodes.name: feature_selector_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level feature-selector routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered selector.

nodes.name: feature_selector_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public feature-selector fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing delegated callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object = None, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and packages references without fitting selectors or delegate estimators.

nodes.name: feature_selector_transform_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public feature-selector transform-like payload without executing the method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense method input and packages references, leaving transform, inverse-transform, prediction, or scoring to sklearn.

nodes.name: feature_selector_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public feature selector object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same selector object.

nodes.name: feature_selector_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted support-mask, ranking, selected-feature, delegate-estimator, and CV-result metadata after delegated selector execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes already-fitted feature support and optional ranking arrays proportional to feature count.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 3 and Case 4 public feature-selector shells over estimator, importance, scorer, and CV callback boundaries
limitations: Delegate estimators, importance extraction, scorer callbacks, CV splitters, greedy subset scoring, recursive elimination loops, and final estimator fitting are arbitrary delegated behavior.

The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not selector loop execution, estimator training, importance computation, CV scoring, prediction, transform, inverse-transform, or scoring internals.
